from markdownify import MarkdownConverter, ATX_CLOSED, BACKSLASH

closed = MarkdownConverter(heading_style=ATX_CLOSED).convert_hN(
    7, None, '  Deep\nHeading  ', set()
).replace('\n', '|')
soft = MarkdownConverter().convert_br(None, '', set()).replace('\n', '<NL>')
hard = MarkdownConverter(newline_style=BACKSLASH).convert_br(None, '', set()).replace('\n', '<NL>')

print([closed, soft, hard])
print(closed.count('#'))
print(hard)
